diagnostics.title: Connection diagnostic
diagnostics.help: The last 100 events from this tab only, kept in memory until reload. No identity, cookies, tokens, URLs or conversation content. HTTP errors do not identify which server component failed. Nothing is uploaded automatically. Available again on the Logs page after recovery.

events.renewalHint: Sign-in hint received; fresh verification required

reasons.proxyRedirect: Sign-in redirect; not proof of expiration

setup.title: Set up your platform
setup.loadError: Unable to verify installation state. No access has been opened.
setup.accountStep: Step 2 of 2 — Create the first administrator
setup.activationHelp: Run this command in your server console to obtain your activation code:
setup.codeHelp: The code expires after 15 minutes, is single-use and must not be shared. Running the command again invalidates the previous code and any unfinished setup session.
setup.codeError: Invalid, expired or temporarily blocked code. Check it; after repeated failures wait one minute or generate a new code on the server.
setup.accountHelp: Create your local account. Use a password of at least 12 characters. Usernames accept 3–64 letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. No email service or SSO is required at this stage.
setup.createError: Unable to create the account. Check your details and session validity. If an interruption sealed setup without creating the account, recover from the server console using --retry-interrupted.
setup.done: Initial setup is now closed. Sign in with the account you just created.
setup.nextSteps: You can then configure Codex, optional SSO and other settings in administration.

impersonation.confirm: Test the platform as {{name}} for 30 minutes? Changes are real and will be audited with your administrator identity.
impersonation.banner: Testing as {{name}} — administrator: {{administrator}}. Changes are real and audited.
impersonation.expired: The test has ended or is no longer valid. Return to your account to continue.
impersonation.error: Unable to switch identity. Check your permissions and try again.

login.localHelp: Sign in with your local account.
login.apiKeyHelp: Enter your API key to continue.

access.connectionInterrupted: The server is temporarily unavailable, for example during a restart or update. This page retries automatically and will resume once the server is available and your identity has been verified. You can stay on this window.
access.proxySessionExpired: Your sign-in session needs to be renewed. Restore connection opens a separate sign-in window without reloading this page.
access.retained: Your work remains in memory in this tab. Actions are paused until your identity is verified; no submission or change is replayed automatically.
access.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow popups for this site, then click Restore connection again.
access.renewed: Connection restored. You can close this window and return to your work in the original tab.
access.identityChangedHelp: This tab stays locked to avoid mixing data from different identities or permission levels. Sign in with the original account and permissions to resume it, or open Mergeron in a new tab to work with the new permissions.
access.inactivePerson: Your login is not linked to an active person. Contact an administrator.
